selection_rationale: The selection prioritizes high-quality surveys and benchmarks to establish a comprehensive framework for evaluating LLM agents. It covers foundational LLM surveys (2307.06435, 2303.18223), specific agent surveys (W4393065402, 2309.07864), and evaluation-focused surveys (2307.03109, 2507.21504). Benchmarks for tool use (W4389518608) and complex medical tasks (W4413801638) are included to address specific sub-themes. Reserve items include duplicates, domain-specific applications, and foundational technical reports to ensure depth and coverage of potential gaps.
anticipated_gaps: Specific benchmarks for long-horizon task planning and memory persistence beyond the medical domain.
Detailed analysis of reproducibility issues in agent benchmarks.
Comparative studies on the effectiveness of different memory architectures (episodic vs semantic) in agents.
